Synopsis:
    UK GDP surprised to the upside at +0.4% in July (vs. 0.0% consensus), driven by services strength partially offset by weakness in production and construction. Annual growth hit 1.6%, the fastest since Feb 2025. The UK led G7 growth in H1 2026 at +1.0%. The U.S.-Iran war is pushing oil above $105/bbl, threatening inflation — BoE now sees CPI rising to ~3.2%. BoE Governor Bailey flagged data is coming in stronger than expected. AI is cited as a driver in software/services.
